name: THE CLERK
note: THE LOBBY CLERK, at the Improvement Company's high desk. Docs 05, 49 and 54 place him ("High enough that you address the clerk's collar"; "Free, insists the clerk"; "The clerk, breathing through his nose with the patience of a professional") and no document gives him a tree, a bark or an appearance (the readiness gate: he is not spoken to). So he is a neat, thin young clerk of the 1850s -- hair pomaded and parted in the middle, a high stiff collar, sleeve garters, a dark waistcoat (errata 83 B). Drawn first in room-10's composition master beside Thad (style gate step 1), then alone on magenta in five poses (room-10 operation 3), keyed by tools/art/room10-clerk.py. BEHIND THE DESK, as Sump is behind his counter: the sheet stops at the desk top's front edge, so `y` is the row under his resting hands, not his feet. Present in every act: no document removes him.
barksNote: Doc 07 writes no barks for the lobby clerk, and no document writes him a line.

sprite.frameNote: 0 rest (hands on the desk) · 1 breath (derived from rest by tools/rig/ambient-breath.py) · 2 writing · 3 the watch, held up and read · 4 looking up. Breathing on 0 and 1 at `rate`; every `breakEvery` seconds one break from the pool: he writes, he reads his watch, he looks up (errata 35 and 77: a deliberate action at least every 30 s).
